_GUIDE.what: WASP ULTRA MASTER CONFIG - har phase (P2->P11 ULTRA modules) ek hi file se control hota hai
_GUIDE.how_use_1: is file ko apne pack me 'config.json' naam se wasp.py ke bagal me rakho - saare flat keys seedhe Cfg me load ho jaate hain (zero patch)
_GUIDE.how_use_2: python3 wasp_config.py doctor    -> sanity + RWX + security-model checks (--fix se auto-repair)
_GUIDE.how_use_3: python3 wasp_config.py profile redteam -> profile values flat keys me likh degi (har phase use karega)
_GUIDE.how_use_4: python3 wasp_config.py bypass 403 /admin  | bypass jwt <token> | bypass encode '<payload>' | bypass cors | bypass ratelimit
_GUIDE.how_use_5: python3 wasp_config.py explain [key] -> har key ka Hinglish matlab
_GUIDE.precedence: CLI flags (--rate etc.) > CLI --profile > profiles.<name> (engine apply) > flat keys yahan > wasp_core defaults
_GUIDE.security_rule: TARGETS = sirf READ-ONLY (GET/HEAD/OPTIONS) + scope firewall | RESULTS = rwxrwxrwx (0777) | writes = sirf triple opt-in

security_model._doc: NON-NEGOTIABLE. Layer4: targets par sirf read-only methods. rwx sirf RESULT files par.

profiles._doc: engine profile: python3 wasp_config.py profile <name>. core 4 (stealth/normal/fast/audit) bhi wasp.py --profile se chalte hain.

ghost._hint: silent recon - WAF ke radar se bahar, sabse slow, sabse kam noise

stealth._hint: chupke chupke - kam rate + UA rotation + jitter zyada

balanced._hint: default - accuracy aur noise ka best mix

redteam._hint: engagement mode - bypass engines ON, budgets max, evidence poora

audit._hint: compliance/audit - poora evidence, kam probing, report-first
